name: io.github.shakaran/symfony-agent-mcp
title: Symfony Agent MCP
description: Read-only Symfony introspection: routes, services, entities, Doctrine, security, Twig and more.

environmentVariables.name: SYMFONY_MCP_DYNAMIC_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Progressive tool discovery. Left on, tools/list advertises five discovery meta-tools and the rest become callable once a category is activated (~828 tokens on connect). Set to false to advertise all 1,677 up front (~154,000).

environmentVariables.name: SYMFONY_MCP_TOKEN_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Token ceiling for the schemas a session may have active at once.

environmentVariables.name: SYMFONY_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Colon-separated allowlist of directories the server may read. Any app_path outside them is refused.

environmentVariables.name: SYMFONY_MCP_SESSION_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Enables session-token authentication. Unset, authentication is off.

environmentVariables.name: SYMFONY_MCP_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Client-side token, required only once SYMFONY_MCP_SESSION_SECRET is set.

environmentVariables.name: SYMFONY_MCP_AUDIT
environmentVariables.description: Encrypted audit log of every tool call.

environmentVariables.name: SYMFONY_MCP_DLP
environmentVariables.description: Scan every result for credentials before returning it. Turning this off is reported as CRITICAL by the startup audit.
